description: Hooks of this eca: aos functions run when an event happens. eca has before_queue, after_queue, brain_failed (CliFailed / ReplyMissing) and tool_added in aos-eca-turn, and before_tool / after_tool only for aos tools called through aos-mcp; the CLI's own tools and what a person types on the screen are not seen. The stack copy of this file overrides it by name, null turns one off.
